description: EasyPost label and tracking data stored on orders

easypost_status.description: label_purchased once a label is bought; voided after the label is refunded

easypost_shipment_id.description: EasyPost shipment ID (shp_…) of the label

easypost_carrier.description: Carrier of the label, e.g. USPS

easypost_service.description: Carrier service of the label, e.g. Priority

easypost_label_date.description: When the label was bought; tracking is refreshed for 60 days after

easypost_refund_status.description: submitted, refunded or rejected after the label is voided

easypost_swell_shipment_id.description: Swell shipment created from the label

easypost_tracking_status.description: EasyPost tracker status, e.g. in_transit or delivered

easypost_tracking_date.description: Time of the latest applied tracker update, used to skip out-of-order updates

easypost_checked_at.description: Last time the tracker was refreshed
